skills.name: wyatt-documents
skills.description: Find, read, summarize, create, and safely edit markdown documents in a Wyatt workspace. Use when the user wants to locate workspace knowledge, work with a Wyatt document, or save new material into Wyatt.
skills.description_zh: 在Wyatt工作区查找、读取、总结、创建和安全编辑Markdown文档，用于查找知识、处理既有文档或保存新资料。

skills.name: wyatt-tasks
skills.description: Inspect, create, update, and resolve tasks in a Wyatt workspace, understand prioritized next actions, and delegate durable work to a background Wyatt agent. Use when the user asks what is on their plate, wants task status, wants to add or complete a Wyatt task, or asks Wyatt to run work asynchronously.
skills.description_zh: 查看、创建、更新和解决Wyatt工作区任务，理解下一优先行动，并可将持久任务交给后台Wyatt代理异步处理。

skills.name: wyatt-workspace
skills.description: Connect to a Wyatt workspace and get oriented by resolving the workspace and loading its overview, recent documents, open tasks, and prioritized next actions. Use at the start of Wyatt work or when the user asks to connect, catch up, or understand what is happening in a workspace.
skills.description_zh: 连接并定位Wyatt工作区，读取概览、近期文档、开放任务和优先行动，用于开始工作、追踪近况或理解工作区当前情况。
